motion_and_interactions.entrance_animation: Fade and slide up using framer-motion (y: 20, opacity: 0 to y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.5)

components.inputs: Shadcn standard, square edges, border-slate-300, focus:border-primary
components.tables: Shadcn table for admin panel, dense spacing, mono-spaced order IDs
components.cards: Minimalist cardless look or 1px border. Product cards should feature large images with sharp typography below.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the application strictly follows a light theme with deep corporate blue accents.
Do NOT use standard rounded cards. Go for sharp edges or max 2px rounded corners.
Use framer-motion for page transitions and scroll reveals, but keep them professional and subtle (no bouncing).
Ensure all form interactions have clear success/error toasts using Sonner.
Build the dashboard using a grid-border technical look (dense tabular data).
Admin dashboard can use a mock authenticated state or direct access for MVP, but orders should be manageable via a central context/store or mock backend.
Implement the email notification requirement mockingly via a console log or mock API call.
Ensure `data-testid` is added to ALL buttons, inputs, links, and major layout sections.
